definitions.gloss: improved model; improved type; upgraded version
definitions.explanation: A modified version of a product, machine, or system that has been enhanced or upgraded from the original. Commonly used in technical and commercial contexts.

examples.japanese: {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}のエンジン。
{従来|じゅうらい}{品|ひん}の{改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}が{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: An improved version of the existing product was released.

examples.japanese: この{改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}は{従来|じゅうらい}のモデルに{比|くら}べて{燃費|ねんぴ}が２０パーセント{向上|こうじょう}している。
examples.english: This improved model has 20% better fuel efficiency compared to the previous model.

notes:
A compound of {改良|かいりょう} (improvement) and {型|がた} (model/type). Frequently used in product descriptions, engineering, and technology contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}を{開発|かいはつ}する: to develop an improved model
- {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}を{投入|とうにゅう}する: to introduce an improved model
- {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}の{発売|はつばい}: release of an improved model

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新型|しんがた}: new model — a completely new design, not just an improvement of the old one
- {最新型|さいしんがた}: latest model — the most recent version available
- {旧型|きゅうがた}: old model — the previous version being replaced
- マイナーチェンジ: minor change — a partial update, often smaller than a full {改良|かいりょう}{型|がた}

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Common in product specifications, technical documentation, and news articles about product releases.
